title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.10646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair. A masked generative transformer generates discrete trajectory candidates in parallel, and Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) uses scene geometry to target where to edit and which prior-supported alternatives to evaluate. This turns refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring beyond local trajectory deformation. MGMP achieves 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Controlled Route Invalidation on Kuka, exceeding the strongest external baselines by 23 and 25 percentage points, respectively. It further generalizes to unseen layouts, additional obstacles, unseen geometries,

translated_title: 基于几何引导标记搜索的掩码生成式运动规划
translated_abstract: 生成式运动规划器通常利用学习到的轨迹先验进行初始生成，而将测试时的修复留给局部连续细化。我们提出了掩码生成式运动规划（MGMP），它将学习到的先验从高效的并行生成扩展到结构化修复。一个掩码生成式Transformer并行生成离散轨迹候选，几何引导标记搜索（GGTS）则利用场景几何来确定编辑位置以及评估哪些受先验支持的替代方案。这将细化过程转化为对离散运动替代方案的高效搜索，实现了超越局部轨迹变形的路线级重构。MGMP在Ring Maze上达到96%的成功率，在Kuka的受控路线失效任务上达到82%的修复成功率，分别超过最强外部基线23和25个百分点。它还能进一步泛化到未见过的布局、额外障碍物和未见过的几何形状。
tldr: 提出掩码生成式运动规划（MGMP）结合几何引导标记搜索（GGTS），将测试时细化转化为离散运动方案上的高效搜索，实现路线级结构重构，在环形迷宫和Kuka路线失效任务上分别取得96%和82%的成功率。
en_tdlr: Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP) with Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) turns test-time refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring and achieving 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Kuka route invalidation.
